svg.title: Per-bucket queries versus the calendar ladder
svg.desc: Left: 1,140 buckets each needing up to four HTTP calls, taking 139 seconds. Right: 97 calendar segments fetched in about five to seven requests, taking 0.64 seconds.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same output. Two very different request counts.
